items.definition:
Not clearly visible or attracting attention
He tried to remain inconspicuous in the crowd.

surrounded by land
Switzerland is a landlocked country in Europe.

extremely hungry
After the long hike, they were all ravenous.

providing or consisting of bare minimum; revealing
She wore a very skimpy bikini to the beach.

not officially attached or connected to an organization or group
He chose to remain unaffiliated with any political party.

not flattering; making someone or something look less attractive or appealing
The photograph was quite unflattering.

not able to be recognized
After years, he was almost unrecognizable.

not planned or arranged to happen at a particular time
The flight had an unscheduled stop due to bad weather.

not formally organized or structured
The meeting was very unstructured, with no clear agenda.

without a voice; unvoiced (phonetics)
The voiceless consonants in English include 'p' and 't'.

without a saddle
She rode the horse bareback across the field.

stupid or foolish
That was a brainless decision.

allowing air to pass through easily
This jacket is made of breathable fabric.

excessively conceited or absorbed in oneself; self-centered
His egotistical behavior made him unpopular with his colleagues.

appearing to be alive or real
The museum displayed a lifelike dinosaur model.

smart and fashionable
He always looks natty in his tailored suits.

having an immediate impact; forceful
The advertisement had a short, punchy slogan.

relating to or characteristic of reptiles
The dinosaur had a reptilian appearance.

relating to sulfur
Sulfuric acid is a highly corrosive substance.

causing a feeling of excited or anxious uncertainty
The movie had a very suspenseful ending.

liable to unreasonable changes of mood
The old car was very temperamental and often wouldn't start.

not protected or watched
He made an unguarded comment that revealed his true feelings.

not based on or in accordance with scientific principles
His conclusions were criticized as unscientific because they lacked evidence.

wild; not domesticated
The wild horses remained untamed, roaming freely across the plains.

fragrant and soothing, often referring to a type of vinegar
She drizzled balsamic vinegar over the fresh salad.

muscular or strong; substantial
The security guard was a big, beefy man.

relating to the former country of Czechoslovakia
The Czechoslovak government was formed after World War I.

Easily excited.
The puppy was very excitable when new visitors arrived.

Playful and full of energy.
The frisky kitten chased its tail around the room.

Relating to Pope Gregory I or Pope Gregory XIII, or to the calendar introduced by the latter.
The Gregorian calendar is the most widely used civil calendar in the world.

Impossible to travel along or over.
The road became impassable after the heavy snowfall.

rude and disrespectful
His insolent remarks angered the teacher.

cheerful and friendly
His jovial nature made him popular with everyone.

not elaborate, showy, or intense; understated
They decided to have a low-key birthday celebration at home.

feeling or appearing casually calm and relaxed
She gave a nonchalant shrug, as if nothing bothered her.

before marriage
They attended premarital counseling sessions before their wedding.

shaped like a pyramid
The company adopted a pyramidal management structure with many layers.

not feeling or showing worry or anxiety about something
She seemed completely unconcerned by the news.

provided with insufficient funds
Many public services are severely underfunded.

having achieved no wins
The team had a winless season.

expressing congratulations
She received many congratulatory messages after her promotion.

extending throughout a whole country
There was a countrywide protest against the new policy.

not in good condition; shaky or unreliable (informal, British English)
My car engine's been a bit dicky lately, so I need to get it checked.

designed for efficiency and comfort in the working environment
She bought an ergonomic chair to improve her posture and reduce back pain at work.

showing courage, determination, or spirit
It was a gutsy decision to quit her job and start her own business.

tall and thin, often awkwardly so
The lanky boy struggled to fit into the small desk.

feeling or expressing sorrow or grief; sad
The mournful sound of the bagpipes filled the air.

stubbornly refusing to change opinion
He was obstinate and refused to admit he was wrong.

childishly sulky or bad-tempered
The child became petulant when he didn't get his way.

full of twists; winding or convoluted
The mountain road was very twisty and challenging to drive.

remaining the same; not changing
Her love for him remained unchanging throughout the years.

not provided with money or financial support
The project was left unfunded and could not proceed.

not satisfied or fulfilled
There are many unmet needs in the community.

not turned over or disturbed
We will leave no stone unturned in our search for the truth.

characteristic of winter, especially in being cold, bleak, or stormy
The wintry weather made driving conditions difficult.

not straight or level; at an angle
The picture on the wall was hanging slightly askew.

having difficulty with reading due to dyslexia
The dyslexic student received extra support in class.

showing no emotion
His face remained emotionless throughout the difficult conversation.

relating to Eritrea or its people
The Eritrean community celebrated their national day.

able to be expanded
The new table is expandable, perfect for dinner parties.

friendly and cheerful
He was a genial host, always making everyone feel welcome.

sexually attractive and muscular
The actor was described as tall and hunky.

containing or using only one color
The artist preferred a monochromatic palette for his landscape paintings.

annoyed or bad-tempered (informal)
He was in a really pissy mood after losing the game.
